3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:db7759d0-7841.title: Founding Clinician- Nephrology
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:db7759d0-7841.description: About 3Y At 3Y Health, we believe physicians deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where physicians can launch and grow your own practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. Why This Role Exists We’re expanding our Nephrology services and need a founding clinician to serve as a part‑time consultant. You will help us shape local care models, expand insurance contracts, and if interested, create a launch‑pad to build or grow your own independent practice—without the usual operational headache. Key Responsibilities - We are looking for a variable commitment, up to 1 hr commitment per week - Advise on policies and outcome metrics to ensure evidence‑based, family‑centered care. - Act as the primary credentialed provider for the group when we are applying to commercial and Medicaid plans in your state. Ideal Candidate - Active Nephrology license in good standing in Florida. - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable private practice care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $300 per hour.

aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:872.title: Staff Accountant (L.A. LIVE)
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:872.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! L.A. LIVE is where Los Angeles comes together. Located in the heart of downtown, it’s a global destination for sports, music, dining, and live entertainment, bringing major events, everyday moments, and the energy of the city into one dynamic district. Owned and operated by AEG, L.A. LIVE is powered by teams who keep things moving behind the scenes, creating experiences that feel seamless, welcoming, and alive. From game days and concerts to community events and nights out, every role helps shape how people experience the city. If you want to be part of a place where culture, community, and live moments intersect and join a company where your work shows up in real time, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. Job Summary: The Staff Accountant will perform professional-level accounting work for the LA LIVE Entertainment District, the JW Marriott/Ritz Carlton at LA LIVE, Global Partnerships, and other AEG-owned real estate entities. This position requires an understanding of basic accounting principles and accounting functions to complete tasks. Responsibilities include accounts payable, performing month-end closing procedures, general ledger maintenance, financial analysis, reconciliation of balance sheet/expense accounts, and other ad hoc projects. Furthermore, this individual will be required to apply accounting knowledge to ensure proper coding and recording of various cost allocations, intercompany transactions, and other miscellaneous journal entries. This individual may also be asked to perform ad-hoc analyses and create spreadsheets and reports for management as necessary. This position will interface with the Accounting Manager to support various tasks on a daily basis. Essential Functions: Manage the end-to-end invoice-to-payment workflow in Perceptive, including General Ledger coding, routing invoices for business unit approval, and proactively following up with department leaders to ensure timely and accurate processing; prepare and execute weekly payment runs (ACH & checks) by generating system batches, securing appropriate approvals, and ensuring payments are accurate, timely, and compliant with internal controls. Prepare and record various journal entries, including accruals, prepaids, and adjusting entries in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Update month-end supporting schedules related to these accounts. Perform and complete the clearing of intercompany suspense accounts and month-end close accounting tasks for assigned entities in accordance with corporate deadlines. May be required to leverage advanced Microsoft Excel functions and formulas, including PivotTables, to summarize, analyze, and format large data sets for accurate reporting and reconciliation purposes. Complete and finalize reclassification and coding of journal entries and expenses, verifying proper allocation across various departments and business units. Perform monthly balance sheet,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b55401e-e7de-.title: Senior Director, Customer Success
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b55401e-e7de-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Customer Success based in United States. This is a senior leadership opportunity focused on shaping and scaling Enterprise Customer Success across the Americas. You will lead a multi-level organization responsible for retention, adoption, customer satisfaction, and expansion across strategic enterprise accounts. The role combines customer-facing executive leadership with organizational strategy, operational excellence, and team development. You will build scalable approaches to customer success, strengthen relationships with senior stakeholders, and drive measurable customer value. Close collaboration with Sales, Renewals, Support, Product, and Engineering will be essential to delivering seamless experiences. This position is ideal for an experienced SaaS leader who thrives in high-growth environments and enjoys building high-performing teams and processes. Lead and develop the Enterprise Customer Success organization across the Americas, managing multiple levels of leadership including Directors and Managers. Define and execute the Enterprise Customer Success strategy, aligning customer engagement models, segmentation, operational processes, and priorities with broader business objectives. Drive retention, adoption, customer satisfaction, and expansion across a complex portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers. Build strong executive relationships with key customers, understand their business priorities, and serve as a senior advisor throughout their customer lifecycle. Take an active leadership role in complex customer escalations, ensuring issues are resolved effectively while protecting long-term relationships and business outcomes. Partner closely with Sales, Renewals, Support, Product, and Engineering to create consistent customer experiences and maximize customer lifetime value. Establish scalable success planning, executive business reviews, value realization frameworks, and other programs designed to demonstrate measurable customer impact. Use customer data, health indicators, and business insights to identify retention risks, improve forecasting, and enable proactive engagement strategies. Coach and mentor Customer Success leaders, establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable performance. Represent the customer voice internally, using customer insights to influence product priorities, go-to-market strategies, and organizational decisions. Develop and operationalize AI-driven processes that improve efficiency and effectiveness across post-sales functions. Travel up to 25% as needed to meet with strategic customers and internal teams. Requirements 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Post-Sales leadership within a B2B SaaS environment, including at least 5 years managing large or multi-level teams. Proven experience leading Enterprise or Global customer relationships, preferably within cybersecurity, email security, enterprise infrastructure, or another complex SaaS environment. Strong business acumen with the ability to understand customer priorities and build trusted relationships with senior executives, including Fortune 500 stakeholders. Demonstrated success scaling Customer Success teams, processes, and operating models within a high-growth organization. Strong understanding of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, and customer value strategies, with experience partnering closely with Sales and Renewal teams. Experience using data, systems, and performance insights to identify risks, improve customer outcomes, and guide strategic decision-making. Proven ability to lead through influence across cross-functional organizations and align diverse stakeholders around shared objectives. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e9ba99e7-03eb-.title: Senior Cyber and AI Sales Representative
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e9ba99e7-03eb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cyber and AI Sales Representative based in the United States. This senior sales role offers the opportunity to drive growth across cybersecurity and AI assurance services for connected products and technologies. You will develop business across the US and Canada, engaging organizations navigating increasingly complex cybersecurity, regulatory, and AI requirements. The role combines strategic account development, consultative selling, technical solution positioning, and new-business generation. You will build relationships with senior technical and commercial stakeholders while translating complex requirements into clear, valuable service solutions. Working closely with technical specialists, laboratories, certification teams, and global sales colleagues, you will guide opportunities from prospecting through negotiation and award. Success will be measured through qualified pipeline growth, new customer acquisition, strategic account expansion, and achievement of revenue and order targets. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced cybersecurity sales professional who thrives in a highly autonomous, client-facing, and fast-moving environment. Develop and execute sales strategies for cybersecurity and AI assurance services across assigned accounts, industries, and territories. Generate new business through targeted prospecting, networking, referrals, industry events, trade shows, and strategic account development. Build and maintain a qualified sales pipeline sufficient to consistently meet or exceed assigned order and revenue targets. Sell cybersecurity and assurance services to product manufacturers, technology companies, industrial organizations, medical device companies, energy businesses, consumer product manufacturers, and other organizations developing or deploying connected products. Lead consultative conversations with prospective and existing customers to understand their products, technologies, regulatory obligations, cybersecurity risks, and business objectives. Translate complex cybersecurity, regulatory, and AI requirements into clear customer needs, solution proposals, and compelling commercial value propositions. Engage credibly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and establish trusted relationships with decision-makers. Collaborate with laboratories, technical specialists, consultants, certification teams, and globally distributed sales teams to develop solutions aligned with customer requirements. Lead the preparation of proposals, quotations, scopes, pricing, and statements of work, progressing opportunities through negotiation and final award. Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and identify opportunities to expand relationships across business units, product offerings, and geographic markets. Support customer presentations, webinars, workshops, conferences, trade shows, and targeted marketing and sales campaigns. Maintain accurate sales activity and opportunity information in CRM systems and provide regular forecasts, account plans, and business-development updates. Spend significant time engaging directly with customers, attending industry events, and developing relationships in the field. Prioritize and organize a demanding workload while maintaining strong customer focus, quality, and responsiveness in a fast-paced environment. Travel extensively as required to support customers, events, and business-development activities. Requirements 5+ years of successful B2B sales experience in cybersecurity, product security, technical consulting, testing, certification, regulatory advisory, or related professional services. Demonstrated success developing new business, building qualified pipelines, and closing complex technical service opportunities. Practical knowledge of product and IoT cybersecurity regulations, standards, and market driver
